name: Copper Powered Rails
summary: Adds a second powered rail recipe that uses copper ingots instead of gold. It yields the same six rails per craft as the vanilla gold recipe.

vanilla_changes.change: Extra recipe: 6 copper ingots + 1 stick + 1 redstone in the vanilla powered-rail layout (X X / X#X / XRX, X = copper ingot, # = stick, R = redstone) -> 6 powered rails. The vanilla gold-ingot recipe still works.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Part of the bundled VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks datapack (version 26.2 selection). Recipes are server-side; the datapack is loaded via Paxi.
